rationale: Motor vehicle collision with significant damage to the policyholder's vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder resulting from the impact.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday while stopped at a red light. The other vehicle struck at ~35 mph with no braking; the impact totaled Pat's vehicle with the trunk crushed into the back seat. Pat sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information is available on the police report.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended by other vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
